recommendation: Current public risk state is low Tail with extreme Stress; no live NQ price-path evidence is available during the weekend closure.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low after a two-sided Friday rebound
body: Friday's Nasdaq rebound was modest and two-sided, while the week still ended under pressure from elevated long-term Treasury yields, oil near recent highs and severe Strait of Hormuz disruption. With NQ closed for the weekend, no fresh extension, failed-retracement or session-extreme evidence can be observed; those cross-asset risks therefore remain Stress inputs rather than a current Tail trigger.

lookbackSummary: During the preceding 24 hours, Tail rose from low to WATCH around Friday's U.S. opening/data window, then fell back to low as the rebound became two-sided. One 17:00 UTC slot has no valid published assessment; the remaining history shows Stress staying extreme while Tail decayed into the weekend close.
outlookSummary: The exact next 24 hours are entirely inside the Saturday weekend futures closure. Tail therefore remains low because no live NQ path can be observed; known rates, oil and Hormuz risks keep Stress extreme. The next major scheduled U.S. macro cluster begins after this horizon, on August 25-27.
